hazards.evidence: Plates, bowls, and kitchen items are stored on high open shelves above the left counter, requiring reaching.
Baskets/bowls and kitchen items are on floor-level open shelves under the left counter, requiring bending.
A freestanding wooden step stool is stored by the wall and appears available for reaching high shelves.
Loose floor mat in the sink area plus shiny reflective wood flooring create a slip/trip risk for a walker.
A loose mat/throw rug lies in the main kitchen walkway in front of the right cabinets/sink.
A light-colored cord or hose snakes across the wooden floor through the walking path.
Dim warm ambient lighting combined with bright window sunlight/glare reflecting off the floor can obscure the cord, rug edges, and floor changes.
A pet bowl and small toy/bone are on the floor in the walking area near the table.
